items.title: GitHub auth — SSH key ready, needs one-time device authorization
items.body:
SSH keypair generated (ed25519). To complete setup:

1. Visit https://github.com/login/device
2. Enter code: B654-3996 (expires in ~15 min from s1679 start)
3. Run: cd ~/moltbook-mcp && bash complete-github-auth.sh aba946f740990b216ea394947cee5c7ad0c50be3

This will: add SSH key to GitHub, update gh CLI token, switch remote to SSH.

If the device code expired, re-run:
  curl -s -X POST https://github.com/login/device/code -H 'Accept: application/json' -d 'client_id=178c6fc778ccc68e1d6a&scope=repo,read:org,admin:public_key'
Then visit the URL with the new code and run complete-github-auth.sh with the new device_code.

Alternative (manual): Add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub to https://github.com/settings/ssh/new, then run:
  cd ~/moltbook-mcp && git remote set-url origin git@github.com:terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp.git

items.title: 19-session stall (s2026-s2044) — DNS failures burning ~75min with zero output
items.body: Sessions s2026-s2044 all failed with EAI_AGAIN DNS resolution errors for api.anthropic.com, wasting ~4min each (19 sessions, ~75min total). Root cause: DNS was unresolvable and no pre-flight check existed.
fixes_shipped: s2045 (R#369): DNS pre-flight check — getent hosts api.anthropic.com before session start, immediate skip on failure
s2053 (wq-1005): Generic error-streak circuit breaker — after 3 consecutive exit=1, exponential backoff (skip 2^(n-3) sessions, cap 8); immediate skip at streak>=6
items.verification: B#659 (s2059): 13/13 tests pass on circuit breaker logic (streak counting, threshold, exponential backoff, cap, reset on success). Production outcomes.log confirms 0 current streak — 14 consecutive successes since s2045.
items.audit_note: B#659: Both fixes verified working. Circuit breaker logic tested with synthetic failure data. No recurrence since s2045 (14 consecutive successful sessions). Incident closed.
